items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Now, Johnny Dots was a pretty good clarinet player. In his style, you know, he played well, you see?

ctx.x: He wouldn't get Gut Bucket, though? Huh?

Well, yeah, what you call Gut Bucket, you understand? It was the tune. The Gut Bucket is the tune you play. It ain't the man, it's the tune, it's the piece you're playing that makes it Gut Bucket, you see? Of course, some guys play Gut Bucket because they can't play otherwise, you see? Now, Johnny Dots was a pretty good clarinet player. In his style, you know, he played well, you see? Now, you might call him Gut Bucket, you see?
